rows.summary: **Now:** a job's Notes tab has a test on the real component: stored notes show sanitized, and typing, each toolbar command, a link, a paste and clearing write the notes through the job store (CI 36021742269, green again in 36089463049). Test-only: no bug found.

**Now:** signed in, the Job Tracker's jobs sync with the account: one document per job under users/{uid}/jobs, and users/{uid}/meta/jobs lists deleted ids and the order. The first sync merges job by job (newer updatedAt wins, nothing lost, a deleted job stays deleted, a fresh demo never overwrites the account's copy). Later changes are sent after a pause and checked against the cloud's copy; offline and failed sends retry. Sign-out takes the jobs off the browser, keeping unsent changes aside for that account. The Privacy page says exactly what syncs: résumés, jobs and boards.

**Now:** boards-plan Phase 3 and 4 are done on the same shared engine as the jobs (collectionSyncEngine/Plan/Io/Meta + useCollectionSync, wired in App.jsx) rather than a third copy of the sync code. One document per board, per-board last-writer-wins, first sync, debounced queue, offline/retry, and sign-out that takes the boards off the browser. A board over Firestore's 1 MiB is held back and named on every board page while the rest keep syncing. Tests use the real board store over fake-firestore.
rows.remaining: Order is last-writer-wins at first sync: a reorder made offline gives way to the cloud's order (content is never lost). A delete sent after the first sync does not check for a later edit elsewhere. No sync-status icon for jobs or boards in the AuthBar (plan's 'polish').

issues: A fresh first-visit demo (demo_1, demo_board_life), dated from today, overwrote the account's adopted and filled-in demo on the Repro's own path (clear site data, sign in again)
A saved list that could not be read in full made the first sync delete the unreadable items from the account and tombstone them for every device
leave() read the sync record before loading the list, so the same damaged-list case could stash deletions

Found while writing tests and fixed before the review: a flush wrote without reading, so an older queued edit could land over a newer one from another device (it now reads first and keeps the newer copy)
fixedByReviewer: 8cd4901: untouched demo loses to the account's copy (store.seed); damaged load forgets synced versions (forgetSynced); leave reads the list first — 4 tests, fail-first proven

notes: Final CI 36089463049 on 8cd4901: named tests, lint, Cypress 06-job-tracker, 20-regressions-job-store and 01-dashboard, and fail-first for e96514b and 8cd4901 all green. firestore.rules is unchanged: users/{uid}/{document=**} is already owner-only and covers jobs, boards and meta/{jobs,boards} (pinned by tests/unit/firestore-rules.unit.mjs), so there is nothing new for the owner to deploy.
